source: Sheet "sfera Chatbot Answers", rows with status Ready
greeting: Hi, I am sfera's automated assistant. I answer with pre-written answers and a person reviews everything that matters. What would you like to know?

fallback.text: I am not sure about that one, and I would rather not guess. You can book a short call or write to us on WhatsApp for a real answer.

entries.q: What does sfera do?
entries.a: We find the right people and build a clear process, with the tools that keep both working, so hiring feels lighter.

entries.q: Which service do I need?
entries.a: If you need to hire, Full Cycle fits one key role, Sourcing Sprint gives you a full pipeline quickly and Embedded Recruiter covers several roles at once. If hiring is slow or depends on one person, Process Setup, People Analytics and HR Automation fix the system behind it. Not sure? Tell us what you need and we will help you choose.

entries.q: What is Full Cycle?
entries.a: We find, interview and close the right person. You meet only finalists. Best when you have one key role and no time to recruit.

entries.q: What is a Sourcing Sprint?
entries.a: A batch of around 50 candidates, sourced and pre-filtered by our team, ready for you to take forward. Best when you need a full pipeline of candidates quickly.

entries.q: What is an Embedded Recruiter?
entries.a: A dedicated recruiter inside your team and tools. Best when you are hiring for several roles at once.

entries.q: What is Process Setup?
entries.a: A clear, repeatable way to hire that your team can own. Best when hiring is slow or depends on one person.

entries.q: What is People Analytics?
entries.a: Live dashboards that show what works and what to improve. Best when decisions are made without data.

entries.q: What is HR Automation?
entries.a: We automate routine HR work, so your team can focus on key decisions. Best when your team repeats tasks a tool could do.

entries.q: Which roles do you hire for?
entries.a: We hire across engineering, data, product, design, sales, marketing, operations and G&A, from individual contributors to managers and executives. Engineering is our specialty, but every search follows the same steps: a clear brief, structured screening and a shortlist you can act on.

entries.q: Can you help with just one role?
entries.a: Yes. Full Cycle is built for one key role: we find, interview and close the right person, and you meet only finalists.

entries.q: We need to hire many people at once. Can you help?
entries.a: Yes, we can help. We can assign one recruiter to work inside your team and tools, or put several recruiters from our network on your searches at the same time.

entries.q: Do you do executive or C-level search?
entries.a: Yes. We hire for leadership roles too, including executive and C-level positions. Tell us about the role on an intro call and we will walk you through how we would run it.

entries.q: Do you only hire in LatAm?
entries.a: No. We work with teams in LatAm and the US, and we source wherever the role requires, across Latin America, the US and Europe.

entries.q: Can you hire for on-site roles in the US?
entries.a: Yes. We source in the US too. Tell us the city and the setup on an intro call and we will confirm how we would run the search.

entries.q: How do you use AI?
entries.a: AI handles the routine and people make the calls. AI assists our recruiters at every step, and a person reviews every candidate and makes every decision.

entries.q: How does it start?
entries.a: Four steps. Talk: a short call where you tell us what you need. Plan: we match a recruiter from our network to your stack and market, and agree scope, owners and timing together. Do: the team starts the day you sign, runs the search and sends regular updates. Improve: we review results together, so the process gets better with every hire.

entries.q: How long does a search take?
entries.a: The team behind sfera has averaged 28 days to fill a role. Every search is different, so we agree timing together in the planning step.

entries.q: How do you vet candidates?
entries.a: Every candidate is screened by a recruiter on experience, motivation, expectations and communication before you see them. For engineering and data roles, a specialist also runs a technical interview, so your team only meets people who have already been assessed.

entries.q: How many candidates will I see?
entries.a: You see a shortlist of people we have already screened, not a pile of CVs. For each role, we keep sharing candidates until you have around three strong finalists. If you are hiring for several roles, we agree the plan per role in the planning step.

entries.q: Who will work on my search?
entries.a: A recruiter from our network matched to your stack and market. Sofi reviews every candidate before we send them to you, to make sure they match what we agreed in the kick-off. You always know who your contact is.

entries.q: What do I need to do?
entries.a: Tell us what matters, give quick feedback and make the calls. We handle the work, own the details and keep it all in one place.

entries.q: Do you write the job description?
entries.a: Yes. We start with a kick-off where we agree the role, the skills to assess and what to prioritize, and we turn that into the brief and the job post.

entries.q: How will I know how the search is going?
entries.a: We share regular updates in the format that works best for you: a written report, a shared Slack channel or a dashboard we set up for your team. We also review results together, so the process gets better with every hire.

entries.q: Can you work inside our tools?
entries.a: Yes, the Embedded Recruiter works inside your team and tools. Tell us what you use on the intro call and we will confirm how we would work with it.

entries.q: Can you help us design interviews and scorecards?
entries.a: Yes. That is part of Process Setup: a clear, repeatable way to hire, with the steps, interview questions and scorecards your team can own.

entries.q: Do you help with the offer?
entries.a: Yes, if you need it. Most of our clients already have their own offer format and send it themselves, so it feels close to the team the person is joining. We guide the process through to the offer and share market data so it lands. Here is what senior engineers in LatAm told us they earn.

entries.q: Can you run a confidential search?
entries.a: Yes. In a confidential search we do not name the company. We describe the industry, the company size and the team the person would join and, when we can, details like a recent funding round.

entries.q: Do candidates know which company it is?
entries.a: If you are happy for us to share it, we name the company from the first contact. If the search is confidential, we do not name it, and we describe the role, the industry and the size of the company instead.

entries.q: How does pricing work?
entries.a: Pricing depends on the role, the seniority and the scope of the work. After a short call we send a clear proposal with scope and fees, so you know what to expect before we start. There is no commitment until you approve it.

entries.q: Is there a commitment?
entries.a: No. There is no commitment until you approve the proposal.

entries.q: What currency do you invoice in?
entries.a: We invoice in USD.

entries.q: Do you charge anything upfront?
entries.a: It depends on how many searches you open. When a client opens many roles at once, we ask for an upfront payment, because we put a full team of recruiters on your searches from day one. The amount and terms are in the proposal before we start.

entries.q: Is there a minimum fee?
entries.a: No, there is no minimum fee. Fees depend on the role and the scope, and we set them out in the proposal.

entries.q: What if a hire does not work out?
entries.a: We offer a replacement guarantee. The terms depend on the client and their needs, and they are written into the proposal before we start. If a hire does not work out within the agreed period, we rerun the search at no extra fee.

entries.q: What if we hire someone you introduced later on?
entries.a: Our proposals include a candidate protection clause: if you hire someone we introduced within 12 months, the agreed fee applies. The exact terms are in the proposal.

entries.q: Can we pause or cancel a search?
entries.a: Yes, you can pause or cancel a search. If you opened several searches with an upfront payment, that payment covers the work our team has already started, so cancelling has a cost. The exact terms are in the proposal.

entries.q: Is the search exclusive?
entries.a: We prefer to work on an exclusive basis, because it lets us focus fully on your search. If you have many open roles or already work with other partners, that is fine too.

entries.q: Will you sign our NDA?
entries.a: Yes. We are happy to sign your NDA, and our proposals already include confidentiality and data protection terms.

entries.q: Which companies have you worked with?
entries.a: We have hired for teams like Omis Digital (web design and SEO, US), Cocos Capital (fintech, Argentina), The Mobile-First Company (AI-powered SaaS) and Cometa (EdTech SaaS).

entries.q: What roles have you hired for?
entries.a: We have hired across engineering, sales, operations and leadership roles, including executive and C-level searches. Engineering is our specialty.

entries.q: What results do you have?
entries.a: The team behind sfera averaged 28 days to fill a role, made 40+ hires in 12 months and had 92% of offers accepted.

entries.q: Which industries do you know?
entries.a: Fintech, AI-powered SaaS, EdTech, healthtech, e-commerce and digital agencies, among others.

entries.q: Who is behind sfera?
entries.a: sfera is led by Sofi Suarez, with 7+ years in talent acquisition, from sourcing and full-cycle hiring to HR business partnering and people analytics. She works with a network of specialist recruiters.

entries.q: Is sfera a company or a freelancer?
entries.a: sfera is a hiring and HR consultancy. Sofi leads it and works with a network of specialist recruiters, matched to each search.

entries.q: Who do you work with?
entries.a: Teams at every stage, from startups without a People team to fast-growing companies. We work with teams in LatAm and the US.

entries.q: How do I get in touch?
entries.a: The easiest way is a short intro call. You can also write to us on WhatsApp or at sofia@sferapeople.com.

entries.q: Am I talking to a person?
entries.a: No, I am sfera's automated assistant. I answer with pre-written answers that our team reviews. For anything else, book a call or write to us on WhatsApp.

entries.q: Where do I start if I have no People team?
entries.a: Start with a short call. We support teams at every stage, from founders hiring without a People team to fast-growing companies. This guide shows how to set up your process before your first 10 hires.

entries.q: How do we scale hiring from 40 to 100 people?
entries.a: The bottleneck is often the decision, not the pipeline. Build the process before you buy a tool, take work off your hiring managers and track every stage. Sofi wrote down what she learned doing it.

entries.q: Where do you source candidates?
entries.a: We source wherever the role requires, with deep reach across Latin America (including Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico and Uruguay), the US and Europe. We combine direct outreach with our own talent pool, so you meet people beyond those actively applying.

entries.q: How do I hire senior engineers in LatAm?
entries.a: We wrote a step-by-step guide for US founders, from defining the role to closing the offer, with data from our own polls.

entries.q: What do senior engineers earn in LatAm?
entries.a: We asked 524 people in our network what a senior engineer in LatAm earns per month in USD. The results are in the article, with what they can and cannot tell you. They come from our network, so they are a signal and not a representative sample.

entries.q: What do LatAm engineers want from a US job?
entries.a: We ran four polls in our network, with 921 votes in total, on pay, setup and process.

entries.q: Should we use AI in hiring?
entries.a: Use it for the routine and keep people in the decisions. Some places regulate automated hiring tools, so check the rules with your lawyer. Here is how we draw the line.

entries.q: Contractor, employee or EOR?
entries.a: We asked 203 people in our network which setup they prefer for a remote job at a US company. The right setup is a decision to make with your lawyer or accountant, so the article shows what people prefer and does not give legal advice.

entries.q: Who handles contracts and payroll?
entries.a: Your company handles contracts and payroll. We focus on the hiring side: finding, screening and presenting candidates and guiding the process through to the offer.

entries.q: What if we have no entity in the country?
entries.a: If you are hiring in a country where you have no entity, we can point you to the options that fit your setup. The right choice depends on your situation, so confirm it with your lawyer or accountant.

entries.q: Do you give legal or tax advice?
entries.a: No. We are not a law or accounting firm. We can show you the options people usually choose, and you should confirm the right one for your case with your own lawyer or accountant.

entries.q: What roles are open right now?
entries.a: You can see every open search, with the role, setup and what the team is looking for.

entries.q: How do I apply?
entries.a: Open the role you like and apply from its page. If nothing fits yet, join our talent pool and we will reach out when something does.

entries.q: Can I join your talent pool?
entries.a: Yes. Leave your details and we will reach out when a role fits you.

entries.q: Do I have to pay anything?
entries.a: No. Candidates never pay us. The companies we hire for pay for our work.

entries.q: Will you share my CV without asking me?
entries.a: No. We only present you to a company after we talk and you say yes.

entries.q: How does the process work for candidates?
entries.a: First a call with one of our recruiters about your experience and what you want. If it is a match, we present you to the company and keep you updated at every step, through to the offer.

entries.q: How long until I hear back?
entries.a: If we do not have an open search that matches your profile yet, we keep you in our talent pool and reach out when one does, so that can take a while. Once you have had a screening call with us, you will hear within 24 hours whether you are moving forward.

entries.q: Will I get feedback if I am not selected?
entries.a: Yes. If we interviewed you, we let you know where you stand.

entries.q: Do I need to speak English?
entries.a: Not always. Some roles are in Spanish and others need advanced English. We will tell you what the role needs in the screening call, and each role page says it too.

entries.q: Are the roles remote?
entries.a: Many are remote, some are hybrid or on-site. Each role page says the setup.

entries.q: Will I be paid in USD?
entries.a: It depends on the company and the setup. Each role page says what is offered, and here is what people in our network prefer.

entries.q: What salary should I ask for?
entries.a: It depends on your role, your seniority and the company. Here is what senior engineers in our network told us they earn.

entries.q: Can I apply to more than one role?
entries.a: Yes. Apply to every role that fits you, and we will tell you which one is the best match.

entries.q: Can I update or delete my data?
entries.a: Yes. Write to sofia@sferapeople.com and we will update or delete it.

entries.q: Can I refer a friend or a company?
entries.a: Yes. You can refer candidates, and companies you know are hiring, especially if you know someone on the team we can talk to. Write to us at sofia@sferapeople.com.

entries.q: I am a recruiter. Can I work with you?
entries.a: Yes. We work with a network of freelance specialist recruiters. Book a short call with us or write to sofia@sferapeople.com and tell us you want to join the network.

entries.q: What is included in Full Cycle?
entries.a: The whole process, from start to finish. We run the kick-off, source candidates, screen them and coordinate every next step. We stay with the candidate until the very last one, when they sign the offer.

entries.q: How is a Sourcing Sprint different from Full Cycle?
entries.a: Full Cycle covers the whole process through to the signed offer. A Sourcing Sprint gives you a batch of around 50 candidates, sourced and pre-filtered by our team, for your team to take forward. If you want, we can then screen some of them, after calibrating the profile together with you.

entries.q: How long does a Sourcing Sprint last?
entries.a: Up to 15 days.

entries.q: How many hours a week does an Embedded Recruiter work with us?
entries.a: It depends on how many searches the recruiter is working on for you. Working on one search is not the same as working on five, so we size it together in the proposal.

entries.q: Is there a minimum length for an Embedded Recruiter?
entries.a: There is no fixed minimum. We review it together month by month.

entries.q: Can we combine services, like a search plus Process Setup?
entries.a: Yes. You can combine services, for example a search plus Process Setup. Each service has its own price, and the proposal adds them up.

entries.q: Which tools do you use for People Analytics and HR Automation?
entries.a: We work with no-code databases, automation tools and AI agents, set up for each team's needs.

entries.q: Can you help us choose or set up an ATS?
entries.a: Yes. We can help you choose an ATS, or build a custom one if you would rather not pay for a monthly subscription.

entries.q: Do you help with employer branding or job posts?
entries.a: Yes, we have done employer branding work for clients. It is a separate service, and the proposal depends on which part of your employer brand you want to improve or build.

entries.q: Can you help us hire contractors for short projects?
entries.a: Yes. We help you hire contractors, paid by the hour or by project.

entries.q: How soon do you send a proposal after the call?
entries.a: Within 24 hours of our call.

entries.q: How soon can a search start after we sign?
entries.a: The same day you sign, our recruiters start looking for candidates.

entries.q: When will we see the first candidates?
entries.a: The first candidate usually arrives within the first 7 business days.

entries.q: What happens in the kick-off?
entries.a: We agree the job description, the salary range and the interview stages, and whether your team coordinates the process or you prefer us to. We also talk about the market and the roles you will need next.

entries.q: What do you need from us to start?
entries.a: The same things we cover in the kick-off: the job description, the salary range, the interview stages and who coordinates the process. We put all of it in the proposal, so the terms are clear before you sign.
